name: search_role_blocks
description: Search another role instance's content and reasoning for a substring or regex pattern and return match offsets with short surrounding windows. Read-only. Match count is capped. Use it to find candidate repetition before window-reading to confirm.

detailed: Searches a role's content and reasoning and returns capped match windows.
tool {participantRole} is searching the role's conversation

pattern.description: The text or regex to search for.

field.description: Optional: restrict the search to 'content' or 'reasoning'. Searches both when omitted.

maxMatches.description: Optional cap on returned matches (default 10; hard-capped).
